prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray (airbrush) tanning or UV tanning beds? I can recommend different salons depending on which you prefer.

I don’t have live web access in this chat, so I can’t pull current ratings — but I can help you find the best local option and evaluate choices. Quick guidance:

What to look for
- Type of tanning: spray/airbrush, stand-up/lay-down UV beds, or sunless booth.
- Hygiene and equipment: clean facility, well-maintained beds/booths, disposable hair/eye protection for spray tans.
- Technician training: certified spray technicians and staff who ask about skin type/meds.
- Product quality: reputable sunless brands (e.g., Mystic, VersaSpa) and quality lotions for beds.
- Recent reviews: check Google Maps, Yelp, Facebook for recent comments about results and customer service.
- Pricing and packages: compare single sessions vs. packages/memberships.
- Safety practices: eye protection, recommended frequency, skin patch test for sprays.

Safety note
- Limit UV exposure; spray tans are safer for avoiding UV risks.
- Never use tanning beds if you’re on photosensitizing medication, have fair skin that burns easily, or have a history of skin cancer. Check with a dermatologist if unsure.

If you want, tell me:
- spray or UV,
- your neighborhood in/near Tyler,
- budget,

and I’ll suggest how to shortlist 3–5 salons and what specific questions to ask each one. If you paste 2–3 salon names or links, I can help compare them.
